discoveryScope: Only declared data roots, manifests and retained synthetic releases; no private stores, credentials, user projects or broad workspace text collection.
existingHeldOutPolicy: Exclude every retained tokenizer evaluation ID and every matching compiled text; task 018 leakage checks also apply. No historical split relabelling.
deduplication: Exact task/input/output payload SHA-256, excluding record ID and provenance metadata; semantic/template family splitting and corpus deduplication remain task 021.

tokens.method: Exact encoding with existing owned tokenizer v1.1.0 as a Gen2 planning proxy only
tokens.specialTokens: No BOS/EOS additions; canonical task/input/output JSON with record IDs and provenance metadata excluded
tokens.countingUnit: Tokens in distinct approved task/input/output payloads after existing held-out and foundation leakage exclusion

planningNote: Exposure ranges are the existing task-017 hypotheses. Repeat scenarios are arithmetic sensitivity, not an approved run plan or a quality guarantee. Gen2 release-ready tokens remain zero until tasks 020-024 produce an admitted corpus/tokenizer release.
removal: Record source revision and downstream lineage, block affected use, run tools/source_removal_impact.py for registered Gen1 sources, and plan governed removal/retraining. Do not delete files or rewrite immutable releases from this inventory.
releases: Write once; changed rights, source bytes, algorithms or counts require a new inventory version. Retain historical receipts.
externalEvidence: Hash bounded publisher/maintainer responses without storing source prose or adding it to a corpus. Observation does not grant training, retrieval or redistribution permission.
